entry_guard.retry_semantics: Recompute every eligible D. A blocked gate does not create an order/fill/new reservation. Existing reservation remains. This is recurring conditional participation, not one cancellation or permanently staying cash.
entry_guard.unknown: Preserve explicit shock_known/positive-scale domain; no invented infinite score or imputation. Blocking requires known finite Z>2.
